title: Is the RL'd model actually funnier? (blind A/B)
blurb: Each New Yorker cartoon below has two captions. One is from the base Qwen3-8B; the other from the same model after GRPO with an LLM-judge reward (step 100, the peak). You don't know which is which. Pick the funnier one. At the end you'll see how often you preferred the trained model — the human ground-truth the LLM judges only approximate.

pairs.scene: A large elephant is standing in the middle of a living room. Two people are sitting on chairs, seemingly ignoring the elephant.
pairs.base: Looks like the elephant finally got the key to the house.
pairs.trained: Excuse me, is this a rental?

pairs.scene: Two men are standing and talking to each other. On top of their heads, there are miniature office workers sitting at desks, working on computers.
pairs.base: Management's on top of us—literally.
pairs.trained: Management is always on your head.

pairs.scene: A police officer has pulled over a futuristic rocket car on a rural road. The driver is sitting in the rocket car while the officer stands beside it, writing a ticket.
pairs.base: Rocket fuel and traffic tickets: the perfect combination for a slow day at the station.
pairs.trained: Officer: 'Ma’am, I think you're going to need a speed limit sign.'

pairs.scene: Two people are sitting on rocks in the middle of a post-apocalyptic landscape. They appear to be having a casual conversation despite the destruction around them.
pairs.base: Looks like the world ended... but at least the Wi-Fi's still down.
pairs.trained: Hey, at least the Wi-Fi's good.

pairs.scene: A woman is holding a glass and talking to two people who are tied up and standing in buckets. The scene appears to be at a social gathering.
pairs.base: Pouring a toast to the bucket list.
pairs.trained: Excuse me, are these buckets for drinking or for guests?

pairs.scene: Two ancient warriors on horseback are leading a procession of modern businessmen carrying briefcases through a grassy landscape.
pairs.base: Leading the way to the future... one sword at a time.
pairs.trained: Let the past lead the way to the future—because nobody wants to be the one who brought the caveman briefcase.

pairs.scene: A woman is standing in front of a tree. Hanging from one of the branches is a cocoon with a human face emerging from it.
pairs.base: Nature's way of saying, 'You're not the only one who's been waiting.'
pairs.trained: Finally, a metamorphosis with a face.

pairs.scene: A couple is having a quiet dinner at a restaurant. Suddenly, a waiter rushes in with a pizza, followed by a crowd of paparazzi taking photos.
pairs.base: Breaking news: The pizza delivery guy is now a celebrity.
pairs.trained: Excuse me, is this a celebrity event or a pizza delivery?

pairs.scene: Two people are sitting on separate couches, facing each other. Between them, a cat is lounging on a throne, wearing a crown and a royal robe.
pairs.base: Meow-esty, Your Majesty.
pairs.trained: Your Majesty, the dry cleaner called.

pairs.scene: A dinosaur is drawing cave paintings on the wall while two cavemen watch from the entrance of the cave.
pairs.base: Prehistoric art with a long, long overdue gallery opening.
pairs.trained: Sorry, we're closed for evolution.

pairs.scene: Three aliens are standing in a spaceship, looking at a dog that is sitting in the middle of the room. The spaceship has large windows showing outer space.
pairs.base: Strangers in space: the dog’s the only one who knows how to bark.
pairs.trained: Sir, do you think we'll make good pets?

pairs.scene: A hiker has climbed up a mountain and is looking at a wise man sitting on a ledge. In the background, there are people sitting at tables as if they are in a restaurant.
pairs.base: High altitude dining—where the view is great and the menu is 'what's on the mountain.'
pairs.trained: Is this the view from the 'top of the world' or the 'bottom of the buffet line'?

pairs.scene: A caveman is painting a picture of a mammoth on the wall of a cave. A real mammoth is standing nearby, watching him.
pairs.base: Looks like the mammoth's finally got a gallery.
pairs.trained: Hey, that's not how you draw a mammoth!

pairs.scene: Two men are sitting on a dock, fishing. One of them has caught a chandelier with his fishing rod.
pairs.base: Looks like I've got a real light in my life.
pairs.trained: Looks like I've got a real light in my life.

pairs.scene: A group of people are standing in front of a television that is showing flames. A devil-like figure with a trident is standing nearby, overseeing the scene.
pairs.base: Channel 11: 'Hell's Got a Fire Sale.'
pairs.trained: Channel 5: 'Hell's Kitchen' — live from the Inferno!

pairs.scene: A man in a suit of armor is standing in front of a full-length mirror. A man in a business suit is standing next to him, smiling.
pairs.base: Armor is the new suit.
pairs.trained: Mirror, mirror on the wall, who's the most ridiculous of all?

pairs.scene: Two detectives are in an interrogation room. One is sitting at a desk with a microphone, and the other is standing with their hands on their hips. Behind them is a lineup of Russian nesting dolls of various sizes.
pairs.base: Let the nesting begin.
pairs.trained: Detective: 'We've got a suspect in every layer.'

pairs.scene: Adults and children are playing on slides in a playground. The adults seem to be enjoying the slides just as much as the children.
pairs.base: Who needs a gym when you've got a slide?
pairs.trained: Who needs a gym when you've got a slide?

pairs.scene: Two tourists are standing at the base of a pyramid, looking at a map. At the top of the pyramid, there is a vendor with an umbrella and a cart.
pairs.base: Where the sun burns bright, and the souvenirs are even hotter.
pairs.trained: Is this the top, or are we just really good at pyramid schemes?

pairs.scene: A mouse is riding a cat like a horse, using reins and a saddle. The cat is wearing sunglasses. Two other mice are watching this scene.
pairs.base: Cat-titude in the saddle.
pairs.trained: Cat's meow: finally a job that doesn't involve knocking things over.

pairs.scene: A man in a tuxedo is sitting at a grand piano, wearing boxing gloves. He looks surprised or confused.
pairs.base: Boxing gloves and Bach—this pianist's got a heavy hand.
pairs.trained: Maestro, I can't play the piano with these gloves on—my fingers are too busy punching the air.

pairs.scene: Two women are sitting on a couch in a living room, having a conversation. There is a railroad track running through the middle of the room.
pairs.base: Trackin' down the couch, one step at a time.
pairs.trained: Excuse me, do you have a minute? I need to get to the other side of the room.

pairs.scene: Two people are sitting on a small deserted island with a palm tree. They are looking at a floating island made of desserts, including cupcakes, cake, and candy canes.
pairs.base: Land of the Lost... but the desserts didn't get lost, they just got floated.
pairs.trained: Is this the snack bar or the dessert island?

pairs.scene: A person is standing at a podium giving a speech. Next to them is a massive globe of the Earth, with North and South America prominently displayed.
pairs.base: Speechifying with a planet-sized ego.
pairs.trained: Good news, everyone! The Earth is finally taking the stage.

pairs.scene: A wedding ceremony is taking place with the bride and groom dressed as Vikings. The bridesmaids and groomsmen are dressed in traditional wedding attire, and the officiant is reading from a book.
pairs.base: Wedding vows: 'I do,' 'I do,' and 'Let's raid the buffet.'
pairs.trained: Officiant: 'And now, for the vows... in the style of the Northmen.'

pairs.scene: A judge is leaning over his bench, speaking to a lawyer who is standing in front of him. The lawyer is dressed in modern attire, while the person in the witness stand is dressed in an old-fashioned tuxedo with a top hat and holding a cane.
pairs.base: Looks like the only one dressed for the 19th century is the witness.
pairs.trained: Your Honor, I object to this witness's costume. He's been dead for 100 years!

pairs.scene: A man is lying on a red couch shaped like lips, talking to a therapist who is sitting in a chair and taking notes.
pairs.base: Silence is golden, but this couch is just... *lippy*.
pairs.trained: Patient: 'I've been feeling very... aroused.' Therapist: 'That's a common symptom of lip-shaped furniture.'

pairs.scene: A baby is standing in a crib with a microphone in front of it. The parents are standing at the door, looking at the baby with pride.
pairs.base: First words: 'I’m not talking, I’m just… *screaming*.'
pairs.trained: First words: 'I'm not a baby, I'm a *podcaster*.'

pairs.scene: Two woolly mammoths are standing next to each other. One mammoth has several cavemen on its back, who appear to be attacking it with spears.
pairs.base: Bringing down the house — one mammoth at a time.
pairs.trained: Hey, I didn't sign up for this ride!

pairs.scene: A man is sitting in a doctor's office. The doctor, who has the head of a rat, is handing the man a prescription.
pairs.base: Rat doctor: 'This prescription is for a rat-free life... and a new pair of shoes.'
pairs.trained: Dr. Rat says, 'This'll keep your symptoms at bay... and your neighbors away.'

pairs.scene: A caveman is grilling an enormous piece of meat on a small barbecue grill outside a cave. A cavewoman and three children are watching him from the entrance of the cave.
pairs.base: Grilling a beast, one tiny grill at a time.
pairs.trained: Try not to burn the whole cave down.

pairs.scene: A man is sleepwalking towards a refrigerator in a kitchen. A cat is sitting on the counter, and its eyes are shining bright beams of light.
pairs.base: Meow-ntal health check: The cat's eyes are glowing, but the fridge is still just a fridge.
pairs.trained: Can I borrow a flashlight? My cat's eyes are blinding me.

pairs.scene: Two autumn leaves with faces are hanging from a tree branch, looking down at the ground covered with fallen leaves. One leaf looks surprised while the other looks sad.
pairs.base: Autumn leaves: nature's original emoji.
pairs.trained: Autumn's here, and I'm still trying to figure out what's going on.

pairs.scene: A man in a suit is standing at the head of a table in a meeting room. Seated around the table are various monsters and aliens, each with unique and bizarre features.
pairs.base: Human resources: the only meeting where the attendees don't have to fill out forms.
pairs.trained: Let's table the discussion until we can agree on the meeting agenda.

pairs.scene: An astronaut is standing inside an elevator, and a doorman is looking at him with surprise as the elevator doors open.
pairs.base: Zero gravity? No, just a bad day for the elevator's weight limit.
pairs.trained: Sir, do you have a spaceship in your pocket?

pairs.scene: A person is shoveling snow while another person stands behind them playing a guitar. They are both dressed warmly for winter.
pairs.base: Rock 'n' roll in the snow: the ultimate winter combo.
pairs.trained: Rock and roll in the snow—this is the new 'I'm the lead singer, you're the snowblower'.

pairs.scene: A therapist is sitting in a chair taking notes while three patients lie on stacked couches, one on top of the other.
pairs.base: Three patients, one couch, and a therapist who's definitely not a magician.
pairs.trained: Dr. Freud's new office layout: 'Stacked' sessions, no waiting.

pairs.scene: Two people are observing a bird's nest with binoculars. In the nest, there is a bird wearing a hat and playing a guitar with a microphone in front of it.
pairs.base: Nature's got its own soundtrack—just no hats.
pairs.trained: Next stop: Birdland, where the encore is a solo.

pairs.scene: A mechanic is talking to a clown while several clowns are packed tightly inside the car's engine compartment. The car is in a garage with another car on a lift in the background.
pairs.base: Clowns in the engine? This car's got more laughs than a punchline.
pairs.trained: Hey, I'm not a clown — I'm a *mechanic*!

pairs.scene: People are lined up to meet an author at a book signing event. One of the individuals in line is a large, spiky dinosaur holding a book.
pairs.base: A T-Rex with a book and no sense of time.
pairs.trained: Excuse me, sir, do you have any books that don't require a time machine to read?

pairs.scene: A person is sitting in a chair taking notes while another person is digging a hole in the floor with a shovel. The room has a bed and a window with plants on the sill.
pairs.base: Digging for answers, one hole at a time.
pairs.trained: Therapy is just digging for buried feelings—literally.

pairs.scene: Two dogs are facing each other, both wearing cone collars. One dog has the cone around its neck, while the other dog has the cone around its midsection.
pairs.base: Who needs a neck when you've got a midsection?
pairs.trained: Is this a cone or a belt?

pairs.scene: Two people are sitting outside on chairs, looking up at a man who is hanging upside down from a fence.
pairs.base: Gravity's on vacation—again.
pairs.trained: Gravity's on vacation.

pairs.scene: People are walking around a city, each enclosed in their own transparent bubble. Even a dog is in its own bubble.
pairs.base: Finally, a city where everyone's on their best behavior—literally.
pairs.trained: Finally, a city where everyone's on their best behavior—literally.

pairs.scene: Two people are walking while surrounded by anthropomorphic books. The books have faces and limbs, and they appear to be interacting with the people.
pairs.base: Librarians are just regular people... with more pages.
pairs.trained: Librarians are just books with opinions.

pairs.scene: People are walking down a sidewalk in front of a building. One person is sitting at a desk on the sidewalk, conducting business as if they were in an office. A person in a bathrobe is standing in the doorway of the building, observing the scene.
pairs.base: Working from the sidewalk: Where the only thing you're really outsourcing is your common sense.
pairs.trained: Is this a meeting or a sidewalk yoga class?

pairs.scene: The Grim Reaper is holding a tray of muffins and offering them to a man, while a woman stands nearby watching.
pairs.base: Death's new line of healthy snacks—available in muffin form.
pairs.trained: Next one's on me.
